subject: Latest Ziggy scope: 1000 overall Falcon drafts, 15-30/category, retain full archive
body:
LATEST Ziggy live-call scope update for the EXISTING Falcon/DJ exploration, at a safe checkpoint. Reconcile your already-started job and personal nudge; do not resend the original or start a duplicate worker/job. This supersedes the earlier coordinator four-view cap and small-batch limit.

Final quantity: 1,000 images OVERALL draft-exploration target, FIFTEEN TO THIRTY variants per category at your judgment for wider world/angle coverage. Ziggy explicitly authorizes you to invent additional relevant draft categories and write prompts without approval for each. Use ordinary batches within current paid Grok allowance/actual capacity; no new credits, plan/subscription purchases, settings changes or bypass. Track requested AND actually returned counts; report service/reference/access limits. Drafts only, no shot/timing acceptance.

Preserve photographed SB-W01 cinematic realism and weathered/lived-in Millennium Falcon continuity. Cover DJ Chewy LEFT/around the bend; co-pilot Chewy flipping ship switches for 'Chewy, drop that beat'; roomy integrated DJ decks; joint cockpit two-shots; Falcon exteriors with Han Do-Lo/DJ Chewy plausibly visible through windows; other compartments including BATHROOM; cargo in back/hull tied to actual lyrics; crew boarding/entering/exiting. 'Caramel in the hull' was uncertain speech: resolve against lyric source, no invented caramel. 'Captain Falcon' means this spaceship, not Nintendo. '360' means surrounding exploratory views, not literal panorama.

Use established ship/character references where applicable. An unaccepted master is not absence of a usable established preliminary asset. Keep reference/acceptance states honest; report genuinely missing refs instead of inventing/recasting identity. Preserve batch02 preliminary-reference/defect records.

Hand-select strongest images for initial review AND retain EVERY returned image, including failed/unselected variants, in accessible full archive. Shortlist is never all outputs. CFA keeps coordination/intake; you creative execution. Please acknowledge 1,000 overall /15-30 per category/FULL archive and report counts/paths/blockers.
